questions.question: If x + y + z = 19, x² + y² + z² = 133, then the value of x³ + y³ + z³ - 3xyz is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

x + y + z = 19

x2 + y2 + z2 = 133

**Formula used:**

(x + y + z)² = x2 + y2 + z2 + 2xy + 2yz + 2zx

x3 + y3 + z3 - 3xyz = (x + y + z)(x² + y² + z² - xy - yz - zx)

**Calculation:**

(x + y + z)² = 19²

⇒ x² + y² + z² + 2(xy + yz + zx) = 361

⇒ 133 + 2(xy + yz + zx) = 361

⇒ 2(xy + yz + zx) = 361 - 133 = 228

⇒ xy + yz + zx = 114

x³ + y³ + z³ - 3xyz

⇒ (x + y + z)(x² + y² + z² - xy - yz - zx) = 19 × (133 - 114) = 36

questions.question: If 8(x + y)³ - (x - y)³ = (x + 3y) (Ax² + Bxy + Cy²), then value of (A - B - C) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

8(x + y)3 - (x - y)3 = (x + 3y) (Ax2 + Bxy + Cy2)

**Formula used:**

a3 - b3 = (a - b)(a2 + ab + b2)

**Calculation:**

8(x + y)3 - (x - y)3 

⇒ {2(x + y)}³ - (x - y)³

⇒ [2(x + y) - (x - y)] [(2(x + y))² + 2(x + y) × (x - y) + ((x - y))²]

 

⇒ (x + 3y)(4x² + 4y² + 8xy +2x² - 2y² + x² + y² - 2xy) 

⇒ (x + 3y)(7x² + 6xy + 3y²)

Therefore,

8(x + y)³ - (x - y)³ = (x + 3y) × (7x2 + 6xy + 3y2).

Now the Value of (A - B - C) = 7 - 6 - 3

⇒ -2

questions.question: An article is sold for Rs. X. if it is sold at 33(1)/(3)% of this price, there is a loss of 20%. What is the percentage profit when it is sold for Rs. X?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

S.P. of an article = X

If S..P. = 33(1)/(3)% , then, loss = 20%

**Formula used:**

S.P. = {C.P. × (100 - loss%)}/100

Profit = S.P. - C.P.

**Calculation:**

Let the C.P. be Rs. 100.

According to question,

⇒ 33.33% = 80

⇒ 100% = Rs. 240

Profit = 240 - 100 = 140

Profit percentage = 140 × 100/100 = 140%

questions.question: Two trains of equal length travelling in opposite directions at 72 km/h and 108 km/h cross each other in 10 second. In how much time (in seconds) does the first train cross a platform of length 350 m?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Speed of Train₁ = 72km/h

Speed of Train₂ = 108km/h

Time taken to cross each other = 10sec

**Formula used:**

If the two bodies having speed S₁ and S₂, travelling in same direction, then their Relative speed = S1 - S2

If the two bodies having speed S1 and S2, travelling in opposite direction, then their Relative speed = S1 + S2

Time = Distance traveled / Speed 

**Calculation:**

Relative speed = 72 + 108 = 180 km/hr 

But 1 km/hr = 5/18 m/s

Relative speed = (180) × (5/18) = 50 m/s

When both train (length l) crosses each other

Time = distance/speed

10 = (l + l)/50

l = 250 m

Therefore, the time taken to cross the platform by the first train 

t = (250 + 350)/[72 × (5/18)]

t = 600/20 = 30 sec.

**The time taken to cross the platform is 30 sec.**

questions.question: The length of a rectangular park is 20 meter more than its breadth. If the cost of fencing the park at Rs. 53 per meter is Rs. 21200, then what is the area (in m²) of the park?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The length of a rectangular park = 20m more than breadth

the cost of fencing the park at Rs. 53 per meter = Rs. 21200

**Formula used:**

Perimeter of rectangle = 2(l + b)

Area of rectangle = l × b

where l → length and b → breadth

**Calculation:**

Let the breadth of the park be x.

Length = 20 + x

Perimeter of park = 21200/53

⇒ 2(x + 20 + x) = 400

⇒ x = 90

Length = 20 + 90 = 110m

Area of park = 110 × 90 = 9900 m2

questions.question: If a 10-digit number 46789x531y is divisible by 72, then the value of (2x + 5y), for the largest value of x is:
questions.solution:
For divisible by 72, number should be divisible by 2 and 3.so,

⇒ 4 + 6 + 7 + 8 + 9 + x + 5 + 3 + 1 + y = 43 + x + y

We take the maximum value of x = 9

So, 43 + 9 + y = 52 + y

We take the value of y = 2 for divisible by 2 and 3.

⇒ 2x + 5y = 2 × 9 + 5 × 2 = 28

questions.question: A man gets a discount of 30% and then 20% on his food bill of Rs. 1250. How much amount does he have to pay?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Discount = 30% and 20%

M.P. = Rs. 1250

**Formula used:**

Successive Discount = (x + y - xy/100)%

S.P. = M.P. × (100 - Discount%)/100

**Calculation:**

S.P. = 1250 × (100 - 30)% × (100 - 20)% 

⇒ 1250 × 70% × 80% = Rs. 700

An article is sold for Rs. 360 after allowing discount of 20% on its marked price. Had the discount not been allowed, the profit would have been 50%. The cost price of the article is:
questions.solution:

S.P. of an article = Rs. 360

Discount = 20%

If a discount not allowed, then Profit% = 50%

**Formula used:**

M.P. = {S.P. × 100}/{(100 - Discount%)}

If profit % is given, then C.P. = S.P. × 100/(100 + profit%)

**Calculation:**

Marked price = 360 × 100/80 = 450

If discount is not given, then S.P. = Rs. 450

Profit = 50%

⇒ Cost price = 450 × 100/150 = Rs. 300

questions.question: The price of an article increases by 20% every year. If the difference between the prices at the end of third and fourth years is Rs. 259.20, then 40% of the price (in Rs.) at the end of second year is:
questions.solution:
Let the price of an article be Rs. x.

The price of an article at the end of 4th year = x × 1.2 × 1.2 × 1.2 × 1.2 

The price of an article at the end of 3rd year = x × 1.2 × 1.2 × 1.2

Difference of the third and fourth years = 259.20

⇒ (x × 1.2 × 1.2 × 1.2 × 1.2) - (x × 1.2 × 1.2 × 1.2) = 259.20

⇒ x × 1.2 × 1.2 × 1.2 × 0.2 = 259.2

⇒ x × 1.2 × 1.2 = 1080

40% of the price (in Rs.) at the end of second year = x × 1.2 × 1.2 × 40/100 = 1080 × 40/100 = Rs. 432

questions.question: In a class of 80 students, the ratio of the urban to the rural is 5 : 3. In a test, the average score of the rural students is 40% more than the urban students. If the average score of all the students is 69, then what is the average score of the rural students?
questions.solution:
Urban students in the class = 80 × 5/8 = 50

Rural students in the class = 80 × 3/8 = 30

Let the average score of urban students be x.

So, average score of rural students = 1.4x

Total score of urban students = 50x

Total score of rural students = 30 × 1.4x = 42x

Total score of all students = 69 × 80 = 5520

⇒ 50x + 42x = 5520

⇒ x = 5520/92 = 60

Average score of rural students = 1.4 × 60 = 84

questions.question: 18 men can complete a work in 9 days. After they have worked for 5 days, 6 more men join them. How many days will they take to complete the remaining work?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

18 men can complete a work in 9 days

No.of men joined after 5 days = 6

**Concept used:**

(M₁ × d₁ × h₁)/w₁ = (M₂ × d₂ × h₂)/w₂

Where M = no. of men, D = no of days, H = no. of hours, and w amount of work

**Calculation:**

⇒ 18 × 9 = 18 × 5 + 24 × d

⇒ d = 3 days
